Hi Hiro / Monica,

Thanks again for the smooth onboarding — the team at Emerga has been running a couple of production-like experiments against the Redwood hosted endpoint and we’re seeing promising results. Two asks from procurement and engineering that I wanted to surface now so we can move to PO/SOW stage: 

1) Trial top-up & credits: We burned through the initial credits faster than expected. Can Redwood provide an additional $5,000 in platform credits to see us through the last phase of evaluation?
2) Trial extension: We need an extra 30 days on the evaluation window to finish latency and throughput validation across our regional traffic spikes.
3) SLA / pricing concession: If we commit to a Q3 pilot (estimated 300k tokens/month), procurement is pushing for a temporary pricing concession — specifically a reduced committed rate (they asked for something in the ballpark of 15% off standard committed pricing) and a written SLA (99.95 for the pilot).

I realize this is a combined ask and may need exec approval. We are close to a PO but procurement is holding until credits/extension and a short-term pricing signal are agreed.

Attached is a compact usage extract (Emerga_MVP_usage.csv) to show we are within pilot expectations. Happy to hop on a quick call if helpful — Ravi / Priya are available M/T/F next week.

Best,
Ravi

Subject: Fwd: Emerga — credits/extension/SLA (request for exec exception)

Team — quick pricing impact note and proposed concession to present for approval. Attachment: SOW-draft.pdf (draft SOW + MAP).

Summary:
- Requested: $5,000 credits + 30 days extension + ~15% committed discount for pilot (first quarter) + written SLA (99.95).
- Estimated near-term revenue: pilot commit ~ $18k/quarter at list → 15% off is ~ $2.7k discount/quarter.
- Cost of credits: $5k one-time credit reduces near-term recognized revenue; margin impact acceptable if it secures a multi-quarter committed conversion.

Proposed one-time exception package (conservative and lower-cost than request):
- Approve $4,500 in one-time account credits (to preserve runway while signaling concession).
- Approve 30-day trial extension.
- Offer a 10% committed discount for the first 3 months of committed capacity (applied to the first invoice after conversion).
- Provide a short pilot SLA in the SOW addendum (we can commit to a written 99.9 baseline with a clear remediation/fallback path; full 99.95 requires legal/ops signoff and a longer-term contract).

Ask: Priyom / Sales Exec please approve the above exception. If approved, I’ll send the SOW addendum and a one-line MSA amendment for legal to review and then confirm with Emerga.

Impact if declined: procurement will likely pause PO until they get closer to the 15% ask; that could push timeline by 3–4 weeks and jeopardize the pilot start date.

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Account Executive — Enterprise Sales
